How to apply
Submit your CV. Submit a separate Selection Criteria response addressing the following two criteria, maximum 1 page.
1. Demonstrated integrity.
2. Effective communication.

Submit your CV and a cover letter addressing the following three criteria, maximum two pages.
1. Project delivery.
2. Stakeholder engagement.
3. Written communication.

Submit your CV and cover letter. The role has the following selection criteria. No separate response to the criteria is required.
1. Communication.
2. Planning.
Applications are invited for this role. Read the position description carefully before applying.
Submit a cover letter with a maximum 2000 characters.
Submit a separate response to the selection criteria, maximum 300 words per criterion.
Provide a Selection Criteria statement with a maximum 900 words in total.
